title: Weirdness
author: Alexis Janson and Patrick Walton
description:
Earth: The only known inhabited planet.
An insignificant pebble infested with insignificant specks of life.

One of these specks, Jace Nyglus, is about to learn of his insignificance.

(Originally written by Alexis Janson for her MegaZeux platform, and ported to Inform by Patrick Walton.)
